# @loom/spec

The Loom kernel manifest — the single machine-readable source of truth aggregating every kernel/SPI version constant, the capability maturity registry, and a deployment compatibility validator. Read-only; imports the real exported constants so it can never drift.

## Entry points

- `@loom/spec`
